event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Broad liquidation, small caps hit hardest.
Phil Fed printed 6.3 vs 20 fc and jobless claims 20.3 vs 19.7 fc, so weak activity data plus VIX at 28.4 produced a 38-up/463-down tape with SPY and QQQ both below their 200-day MAs — now a live CTA sell trigger. SPY +$9.4bn and QQQ +$6.5bn of 5-day inflows got run over; buyers are catching a falling knife into year-end rate risk.

INDICES — VIX 28.4, +12.16% on VIXY.
Ranked: RSP -1.76%, SPY -1.96%, IJH -2.02%, DIA -2.18%, IWM -2.18%, QQQ -2.19%, IJR -2.35%, SOXX -2.75%. Large > small by 0.22pp. Most notable cross-asset move: USO +1.45% against UNG -3.30% and SLV -2.60%. SPY and QQQ both below the 200-day — CTA sell signal is active.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY 1.5x, QQQ vol_ratio n/a in indices list; sector ETFs XLF/XLK/XLV each 1.6x.
SPY 1.5x with price -1.96% = distribution; SOXX 1.4x on -2.75% = distribution; XLE 0.8x is being ignored. Breadth diverges hard: 49% above 50-DMA, 48% above 200-DMA, up/down volume 0.13, new 60d highs/lows 1/67 — participation confirms the sell, not a narrow mega-cap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy -0.65%, XLU Utilities -1.24%, XLP Staples -1.45%, XLF Financials -1.49%, XLRE Real Estate -1.70%, XLK Technology -1.90%, XLI Industrials -2.00%, XLV Healthcare -2.05%, XLB Materials -2.06%, XLC Comms -2.67%, XLY Discretionary -2.79%.
Top industries USO +1.45% and DBA +0.73%; bottom SILJ -5.66% and MSOS -5.59%. Flows contradict price: XLK took +$970mm (100p) while XLU bled -$894mm (0p) and XLE -$674mm (8p). Money is going into semis/AI hardware on the dip and out of defensives — that is short-covering in XLK, not conviction. Label: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.73 (mild complacency) vs QQQ 0.95 and IWM 1.52 (real protection bid in small caps); skew positive across the board, QQQ ATM IV 37.2%. VIX 28.4 vs 20-day 20.9 = elevated fear; VVIX 127.1 vs 107.1. VIXEQ 46.9 vs VIX 28.4 is a wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -1.76% and silver -2.60% falling despite risk-off is the tell: real yields/dollar (UUP +0.03%, 20d +2.53%) are the binding constraint, not fear. Treasuries barely bid (IEF +0.17%) confirms no flight-to-quality. Next FOMC Dec 9, 2026: Polymarket 92% for a 25bp hike, 6% for 50+; CME FedWatch shows hike 100%.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 47, neutral.
PANW +6.42% on 2.8x volume (accumulation), AMD -7.72%, UNH -5.55% on 3.5x volume (distribution), IJS -2.26% on 15.9x. Worst 20d sector XLK -11.87%, best XLY +0.76%. Watch: SOXX -2.75% with 20d -71% and $4.5bn outflows — broken trend; IWM -2.18% with PCR 1.52 — protection is crowded; XLF -1.49% on 1.6x volume — financials distributing ahead of the hike.
